Learn to build a custom harness, folks.

This Microsoft work builds a harness to improve long-context reasoning without synthetic data or post-training.

(bookmark it)

They show that Llama3-8B gains 64.18 points on average across long-context benchmarks with no training at all.

posts.text:
Own your personal agent, folks!

Nod is a new open-source personal agent from n8n Labs. It's Apache 2.0, runs on your Mac, Windows PC, or your own server, and uses the AI provider you choose.

It has its own computer and browser, so it can do jobs across your apps and websites.
posts.quoted: Meet Nod, your own open-source personal agent from n8n Labs Ask it to prep your calls, collect invoices or cancel a subscription It runs on your computer with its own browser to get the job done across apps and websites, using the AI provider you choose

posts.author: omarsar0
posts.name: elvis
posts.text:
Great paper from Meta with practical tips for tuning LLM judges.

This one is on keeping LLM code judges calibrated and tested on a deployed coding agent.

LLM judges often decide whether an agent's code change is good. But their prompts go stale every time the agent changes.

posts.author: omarsar0
posts.name: elvis
posts.text:
Impressive paper from Robbyant on physical AI.

(bookmark it)

Robot hands use a range of tactile sensors, and a model trained on one sensor can struggle to transfer to another.

That's a big challenge in robotics right now.

LingBot-Touch is a foundation model to address this

Memory is one of the biggest open problems for AI agents right now.

Graphon builds one graph across a company's documents, emails, images, and videos without a hand-made schema, so new data does not break it.

On LoCoMo, it reaches 94% accuracy with only 7.9K tokens of context,
posts.quoted: After years working on robot memory at @NASAJPL, @GoogleDeepMind , @Meta and @nvidia, @clarkzhango and I kept asking: why does AI still forget? Today, with @deepakmishraVC, we’re announcing @GraphonAI and our $35M Series A just 6 months after our seed. • #1 on ATM-Bench,

Physical AI is the next frontier. But data is a huge bottleneck.

The big challenge is that robots need to see how people work with their hands. That data is hard to collect and label.

Memories Upload from 
@memories_ai
 turns everyday first-person video into robot training data.
